Leaf & Lineage — Simplified v1.1

The original inheritance and selection model is preserved from release 20261021-10,
commit 81346603e146ecc6dc2c7fe4638cfe754d86a4f9. Version 1.1 adds a teacher Play option.

Teacher setup: https://ragingaxolotl-art.github.io/leaf-and-lineage/simplified/?teacher=1
Uncheck Allow continuous Play, then Create student link. Students see Next generation only.
Try presets in teacher lab applies the same choice locally. Each click advances one round.
Leave the option checked to retain Play and Pause. Existing LL1–LL4 links keep Play.
New Next-generation-only links use LL5. Student links remain under /simplified/.

Open index.html through a web server, or open Leaf-and-Lineage-Simplified.html
as a self-contained offline game. No installation or dependencies are required.
The detailed Pattern Lab remains a separate edition.
